CE TREBUIE SĂ AI ÎN sidebar.js

Îți las un sidebar.js complet care repară:

  • meniul hamburger

  • submenu footer

  • overlay

sidebar.js

JavaScript
/* ========================= */
/* SIDEMENU */
/* ========================= */

const menuBtn = document.getElementById("menuBtn");
const closeMenu = document.getElementById("closeMenu");
const sideMenu = document.getElementById("sideMenu");
const overlay = document.getElementById("overlay");

if (menuBtn && closeMenu && sideMenu && overlay) {

    menuBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

        sideMenu.classList.add("active");
        overlay.classList.add("active");

    });

    closeMenu.addEventListener("click", () => {

        sideMenu.classList.remove("active");
        overlay.classList.remove("active");

    });

    overlay.addEventListener("click", () => {

        sideMenu.classList.remove("active");
        overlay.classList.remove("active");

    });

}

/* ========================= */
/* FOOTER SUBMENU */
/* ========================= */

const footerItems = document.querySelectorAll(".footer-item");

footerItems.forEach(item => {

    item.addEventListener("click", () => {

        const submenu =
            item.nextElementSibling;

        submenu.classList.toggle("show");

    });

});

/* ========================= */
/* SPECIALITIES SLIDER */
/* ========================= */

const specialitiesGrid =
    document.getElementById("specialitiesGrid");

const prevBtn =
    document.getElementById("prevBtn");

const nextBtn =
    document.getElementById("nextBtn");

if (specialitiesGrid && prevBtn && nextBtn) {

    nextBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

        specialitiesGrid.scrollBy({
            left: 300,
            behavior: "smooth"
        });

    });

    prevBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

        specialitiesGrid.scrollBy({
            left: -300,
            behavior: "smooth"
        });

    });

}

4. ADAUGĂ NOUL SEARCH

Pune la FINALUL lui sidebar.js:

JavaScript
/* ========================= */
/* SEARCH SYSTEM */
/* ========================= */

const searchBtn =
    document.getElementById(
        "searchBtn"
    );

const searchBox =
    document.getElementById(
        "searchBox"
    );

const searchInput =
    document.getElementById(
        "searchInput"
    );

if (
    searchBtn &&
    searchBox &&
    searchInput
) {

    /* OPEN SEARCH */

    searchBtn.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {

            searchBox.classList.toggle(
                "active"
            );

            searchInput.focus();

        }
    );

    /* SEARCH */

    searchInput.addEventListener(
        "input",
        () => {

            const value =
                searchInput.value
                    .toLowerCase();

            /* REMOVE OLD */

            document
                .querySelectorAll(
                    ".search-highlight"
                )
                .forEach(card => {

                    card.classList.remove(
                        "search-highlight"
                    );

                });

            /* FEATURES */

            const featureCards =
                document.querySelectorAll(
                    ".feature-card"
                );

            featureCards.forEach(card => {

                if (

                    card.innerText
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .includes(value)

                    &&

                    value !== ""

                ) {

                    card.classList.add(
                        "search-highlight"
                    );

                }

            });

            /* SPECIALITIES */

            const specialityCards =
                document.querySelectorAll(
                    ".speciality-card"
                );

            specialityCards.forEach(card => {

                if (

                    card.innerText
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .includes(value)

                    &&

                    value !== ""

                ) {

                    card.classList.add(
                        "search-highlight"
                    );

                }

            });

        }
    );

}

Acum când apeși 🔍:

  • apare bara de search

  • poți căuta:

    • cardiologie

    • chat

    • video

    • analize

  • cardurile găsite se evidențiază

  • arată modern și premium.

/* ========================= */
/* SEARCH SYSTEM */
/* ========================= */

const searchBtn =
    document.getElementById(
        "searchBtn"
    );

const searchBox =
    document.getElementById(
        "searchBox"
    );

const searchInput =
    document.getElementById(
        "searchInput"
    );

if (
    searchBtn &&
    searchBox &&
    searchInput
) {

    /* OPEN SEARCH */

    searchBtn.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {

            searchBox.classList.toggle(
                "active"
            );

            searchInput.focus();

        }
    );

    /* SEARCH */

    searchInput.addEventListener(
        "input",
        () => {

            const value =
                searchInput.value
                    .toLowerCase();

            /* REMOVE OLD */

            document
                .querySelectorAll(
                    ".search-highlight"
                )
                .forEach(card => {

                    card.classList.remove(
                        "search-highlight"
                    );

                });

            /* FEATURES */

            const featureCards =
                document.querySelectorAll(
                    ".feature-card"
                );

            featureCards.forEach(card => {

                if (

                    card.innerText
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .includes(value)

                    &&

                    value !== ""

                ) {

                    card.classList.add(
                        "search-highlight"
                    );

                }

            });

            /* SPECIALITIES */

            const specialityCards =
                document.querySelectorAll(
                    ".speciality-card"
                );

            specialityCards.forEach(card => {

                if (

                    card.innerText
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .includes(value)

                    &&

                    value !== ""

                ) {

                    card.classList.add(
                        "search-highlight"
                    );

                }

            });

        }
    );

}

JavaScript
/* ========================= */
/* FORMAT TIME */
/* ========================= */

function formatMessageTime(timestamp) {

    if (!timestamp) {

        return "";
    }

    const date =
        timestamp.toDate();

    const now =
        new Date();

    const yesterday =
        new Date();

    yesterday.setDate(
        now.getDate() - 1
    );

    /* TODAY */

    if (

        date.toDateString() ===
        now.toDateString()

    ) {

        return date.toLocaleTimeString(

            "ro-RO",

            {
                hour: "2-digit",
                minute: "2-digit"
            }

        );

    }

    /* YESTERDAY */

    if (

        date.toDateString() ===
        yesterday.toDateString()

    ) {

        return "Ieri";

    }

    /* OTHER DAY */

    return date.toLocaleDateString(

        "ro-RO",

        {
            day: "2-digit",
            month: "2-digit"
        }

    );

}

PASUL 4 — VIDEO.JS

În video.js

Șterge TOT.

🔥

Pune:

JavaScript
/* ========================= */
/* ELEMENTS */
/* ========================= */

const video =

    document.getElementById(
        "video"
    );

const cameraBtn =

    document.getElementById(
        "cameraBtn"
    );

/* ========================= */
/* STREAM */
/* ========================= */

let stream = null;

/* ========================= */
/* CAMERA */
/* ========================= */

cameraBtn.addEventListener(

    "click",

    async () => {

        /* START */

        if (!stream) {

            try {

                stream =

                    await navigator
                        .mediaDevices
                        .getUserMedia(

                            {
                                video: true,
                                audio: true
                            }

                        );

                video.srcObject =
                    stream;

                cameraBtn.innerHTML =

                    `

                    Oprește camera

                    <i class="fa-solid fa-phone-slash"></i>

                    `;

                cameraBtn.style.background =
                    "#ff3b30";

            }

            catch (error) {

                alert(

                    "Camera nu poate fi accesată"

                );

            }

        }

        /* STOP */

        else {

            stream.getTracks().forEach(

                track => {

                    track.stop();

                }

            );

            video.srcObject = null;

            stream = null;

            cameraBtn.innerHTML =

                `

                Pornește camera

                <i class="fa-solid fa-video"></i>

                `;

            cameraBtn.style.background =
                "#4A90E2";

        }

    }

);

🔥

✅ camera live

✅ premium

JavaScript
/* ========================= */
/* ELEMENTS */
/* ========================= */

const video =

    document.getElementById(
        "video"
    );

const cameraBtn =

    document.getElementById(
        "cameraBtn"
    );

const callStatus =

    document.getElementById(
        "callStatus"
    );

/* ========================= */
/* STREAM */
/* ========================= */

let stream = null;

/* ========================= */
/* CAMERA BUTTON */
/* ========================= */

cameraBtn.addEventListener(

    "click",

    async () => {

        /* START CALL */

        if (!stream) {

            try {

                stream =

                    await navigator
                        .mediaDevices
                        .getUserMedia(

                            {
                                video: true,
                                audio: true
                            }

                        );

                video.srcObject =
                    stream;

                callStatus.innerHTML =

                    "Consultația este activă";

                cameraBtn.innerHTML =

                    `

                    Încheie consultația

                    <i class="fa-solid fa-phone-slash"></i>

                    `;

                cameraBtn.classList.add(
                    "end-call"
                );

            }

            catch (error) {

                alert(

                    "Camera sau microfonul nu pot fi accesate"

                );

            }

        }

        /* END CALL */

        else {

            stream.getTracks().forEach(

                track => {

                    track.stop();

                }

            );

            video.srcObject = null;

            stream = null;

            callStatus.innerHTML =

                "Consultația s-a încheiat";

            cameraBtn.innerHTML =

                `

                Intră în consultație

                <i class="fa-solid fa-video"></i>

                `;

            cameraBtn.classList.remove(
                "end-call"
            );

        }

    }

);

.chat-input {

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    gap: 14px;

    padding: 18px 22px;

    background: white;

    border-top:
        1px solid #eee;

}

PASUL 9 — INPUT

Caută:

CSS
.chat-input input

și ÎNLOCUIEȘTE cu:

CSS
.chat-input input {

    flex: 1;

    border: none;

    background: #f0f2f5;

    padding: 16px 20px;

    border-radius: 30px;

    outline: none;

    font-size: 15px;

}

PASUL 10 — SEND BUTTON

Caută:

CSS
.chat-input button

și ÎNLOCUIEȘTE cu:

CSS
.chat-input button {

    width: 52px;

    height: 52px;

    border: none;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: #4A90E2;

    color: white;

    cursor: pointer;

    font-size: 18px;

    transition: 0.2s;

}

.chat-input button:hover {

    transform: scale(1.05);

}

PASUL 11 — ANIMATION

La final adaugă:

CSS
/* ========================= */
/* ANIMATION */
/* ========================= */

@keyframes fadeIn {

    from {

        opacity: 0;

        transform: translateY(10px);

    }

    to {

        opacity: 1;

        transform: translateY(0);

    }

}
